name: WF-130 — Buyer Commitment Failure & Fallback Disposition Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body||$json;const requestId=String(b.request_id||('wf130-'+Date.now()));const dealId=b.deal_id||null,leadId=b.lead_id||null,propertyId=b.property_id||null,buyerCommitmentId=b.buyer_commitment_id||null;const buyerId=b.buyer_id||b.assignee_id||null;const fallbackBuyerId=b.fallback_buyer_id||null;const failureReason=String(b.failure_reason||b.commitment_failure_reason||'').toLowerCase();const reMarket=Boolean(b.re_market||b.remarket||b.return_to_disposition);const dnc=Boolean(b.dnc);const missing=[];if(!dealId)missing.push('deal_id');if(!leadId)missing.push('lead_id');if(!propertyId)missing.push('property_id');if(!buyerCommitmentId)missing.push('buyer_commitment_id');const terminal=['closed','funded','recorded','completed'];const alreadyClosed=terminal.includes(String(b.deal_status||'').toLowerCase());let status='blocked',nextState='human_review',route='human_review',reason='Buyer commitment failure requires disposition review';if(alreadyClosed){status='suppressed';nextState='closed';route='none';reason='Deal is already terminal';}else if(dnc){status='suppressed';nextState='buyer_fallback';route='none';reason='DNC suppresses communication while preserving disposition state';}else if(missing.length){status='blocked';nextState='missing_failure_inputs';reason='Required buyer commitment failure identity is missing';}else if(fallbackBuyerId){status='fallback_ready';nextState='fallback_buyer_validation';route='wf-128-buyer-assignee-matching-exit-execution-controller';reason='Existing fallback buyer is available for separate execution validation';}else if(reMarket||['backed_out','failed','expired','unresponsive','deposit_missing','deposit_failed','declined'].some(x=>failureReason.includes(x))){status='re_market';nextState='disposition_reopen';route='wf-128-buyer-assignee-matching-exit-execution-controller';reason='Primary buyer commitment failed; deal returns to disposition for replacement buyer matching';}else{status='blocked';nextState='buyer_failure_review';route='human_review';reason='Failure reason is ambiguous and requires review';}const id='buyer-fallback:'+dealId+':'+requestId+':v1';return[{json:{workflow:'WF-130',workflow_version:'1.0',request_id:requestId,buyer_fallback_id:id,buyer_commitment_id:buyerCommitmentId,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,buyer_id:buyerId,fallback_buyer_id:fallbackBuyerId,status,next_state:nextState,route,reason,failure_reason:failureReason,missing,re_market:reMarket,guardrails:{no_auto_accept_replacement_buyer:true,no_invented_buyer_commitment:true,closed_deals_are_terminal:true,dnc_suppresses_communication:true,fallback_requires_wf128_validation:true},crm_activity:{activity_type:'buyer_commitment_failure',subject:'WF-130 buyer commitment failure - '+status,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,deal_id:dealId,external_id:id,external_source:'wholesaling-os-disposition',metadata:{status,next_state,route,reason,buyer_commitment_id:buyerCommitmentId,buyer_id:buyerId,fallback_buyer_id:fallbackBuyerId,failure_reason:failureReason,re_market:reMarket,missing}}}}];
